items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer identifies William Holloway as being on the recording ('And this is William Holloway'). The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction with Holloway, only acknowledging the name in the context of the recording personnel.

ctx.x: I MEAN PHILLIPS ISN'T ON THIS ONE.
No, this was made at the Plaza Hotel. This is Joe Haymen. Joe Haymen's brother, Wendell Haymen. And this is William Holloway.
YEAH HOLLOWAY, THAT'S RIGHT, HE BECAME A BANDLEADER LATER ON. WENDELL HAYMEN IS A LITTLE OLDER THAN JOE HAYMEN?
